_doc: Breakage-ready dimension registry (spec-breakage-ready-dimensions-planab-bakeoff-v1). Each entry declares a capability's self-test fn (defined in scripts/dimension-check.sh), its Plan A (primary path), Plan B (fallback floor), and an optional degrade_action (extra command run — beyond the generic log — when the self-test reports broken/degraded, to actively keep the forward roll). Add a dimension = one entry here + a _dc_<name> self-test fn. Consumed by scripts/dimension-check.sh, scripts/dimension-bakeoff.sh, scripts/verify_update.sh (Dimensions section), and `basher dimensions`.

dimensions.plan_b: transcript-synth floor still writes the turn point (minus insight) -- track/lens degrade gracefully, never blank

dimensions.plan_a: pre-tool-guard.sh blocks reset --hard/--abort on a dirty shared tree (cd-aware)
dimensions.plan_b: none -- structural gate, no fallback (fail-obvious only; a break must show BROKEN, never silently pass)

dimensions.plan_a: notify-reset.sh writes the pane-transcript map so `basher lens` targets the EXACT transcript for a pane
dimensions.plan_b: lens falls back to the newest transcript under the pane cwd's project dir when the map is absent/stale
fire-and-forget wscript.exe VBS wrapper -- used when the direct powershell.exe call is blocked/slow (narrow AV exception path)

dimensions.plan_a: harness_upgrade.resolve_master() auto-detects the hub and compares MANIFEST harness_version against canon
dimensions.plan_b: EXPECT_VERSION env override / informational-only 'no canon reference' floor -- never hard-fails when the resolver can't reach a canon
none declared -- an auth-blocked banner tells the operator to sign in manually; there is no automatic degrade (a real gap the bake-off is designed to surface, not paper over)
